#[derive(
    Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, JsonSchema, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd, Serialize, Deserialize,
)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum LegacyCueKindV1 {
    FilePath,
    DirPath,
    Symbol,
    ErrorSignature,
    CommandPattern,
    Dependency,
    ApiSurface,
    TaskClass,
    Subsystem,
    Concept,
}
